title: Promotion narrative scripting and evidence log
summary: Working scratchpad to craft a tight promotion narrative for upcoming calibration cycle. Contains short exemplar stories, impact metrics, suggested phrasing for ask, and a compact evidence roll-up to paste into the review form.
goal_statement: Ask: promotion to Senior People Partner (level bump) with 12% comp adjustment tied to scope increase (owns DEI+L&D programs for Platform Eng). Rationale: consistent delivery of org-level programs, stakeholder trust, and measurable improvements in hiring efficiency and retention.
audience_notes: Primary audience: my manager (Elise), calibration panel, and compensation committee. Tone: confident, concise, fact-first. Use 3x short stories (problem, action, outcome) and 2 metrics. Avoid fluffy language; tie to company priorities (scaling org, ramping Dedicated/private sales).
evidence_bullets: Cut time-to-hire for Platform Engineering ICs from 52 to 38 days — streamlined screening rubric + interviewer training pilot (Q1-Q3 2025)
Piloted mentorship circles for new hires; first cohort retention at 6 months = 94% vs org avg 82%
Led design + launch of L&D micro-curriculum for serving-runtime team; 4 modules, 120 engineers completed, avg NPS 4.3/5
Ownership of cross-functional onboarding checklist reduced first-90-day incident rate for Dedicated infra by ~22% (tracked via post-onboarding retro tags)
Negotiated vendor T&Cs for our assessment tech, saving ~$28k/year while unlocking trial seats for hiring managers
story_1_problem_action_outcome: Problem: Platform Eng reported inconsistent interview signals and slow closures; hiring blocked feature delivery for Dedicated team
Action: Built a lightweight role-specific rubric + 3 interviewer calibration sessions; created score normalization cheat-sheet
Outcome: Average decision time shrank by 31% and hiring manager satisfaction (survey) rose from 2.9 -> 4.2
story_2_problem_action_outcome: Problem: New hires struggled to onboard into GPU/infra-focused workflows; first-month churn risk
Action: Launched mentorship circles + hands-on lab sessions; collaborated with infra engs to build a 2-week ramp checklist
Outcome: 6-month retention for cohort 1 = 94%; onboarding-related PagerDuty escalations down 40% in two quarters
story_3_problem_action_outcome: Problem: Low visibility into cross-team skill gaps impacting rollout timelines (console + optimize features)
Action: Ran a rapid skills-mapping exercise and built micro-curriculum modules prioritized by product roadmaps
Outcome: Product teams reported faster handoffs; three high-priority rollouts met timeline with fewer rework cycles
quant_metrics_for_form: Cohort retention (6 months): 82% org avg -> 94% after pilot
Training reach: 120 engineers completed L&D modules; avg NPS 4.3/5
phrasing_for_ask: Proposed: I appreciate the support over the last 18 months. Based on the measurable improvements in hiring speed, retention, and onboarding reliability for platform teams, I'm requesting promotion to Senior People Partner to reflect expanded scope and impact.
Comp ask: Looking for a title change and a comp adjustment in line with market for the role (guideline: ~12% target increase). Open to discussing timing and stretch goals tied to the promo.
roleplay_script: Manager: Tell me the top outcomes you shipped in the last 12 months.

Me: Focused on three areas — hiring velocity, new-hire retention, and targeted L&D for infra teams. Quick example: we cut decision time by 31% via a rubric and calibration loop, which unblocked the Dedicated team's Q2 hires.
Manager: How does this change your day-to-day if promoted?

Me: I will take full ownership of DEI+L&D for Platform Eng, run calibration/data cadence with hiring managers, and partner on career ladders for senior ICs to reduce backfills and increase internal mobility.
common_questions_and_answers: Q: Why now? A: We have expanded hiring velocity needs tied to Dedicated and Private deployments; capacity risk is real and the programs I run directly reduce that risk.

Q: What are the measurable risks of promoting you? A: Minimal; I already operate at this scope informally and have clearly documented outcomes. Next step would be to formalize deliverables (quarterly OKRs).

Q: If comp committee pushes back, what's flexible? A: I'm open to phased comp carry-forward tied to two milestones: (1) formal ownership of DEI+L&D charter, (2) hitting hiring velocity & retention targets for 2 quarters.
open_questions_for_MANAGER: What examples from your viewpoint would most move calibration? (need 1-2 quotes)
Is there a fiscal timing consideration for comp adjustments this cycle?
Would you be comfortable sharing a short paragraph for the promo packet?

next_steps_short: Finalize numbers + manager quote, build promo packet, rehearse script. Keep this doc minimal and copy evidence bullets into the official form.
notes_to_self: Keep things crisp — panels want evidence and clear scope. Avoid storytelling loops bigger than 2-3 sentences. Use metric first, story second. Bring 1 counterfactual: what would have happened without the intervention.
